source: Simple Choice Real Estate Independent Contractor Agreement (signed 2026-09-05), Exhibit B - Transaction File Checklist ("Complete File")
rule: A file is not complete, and no commission will be disbursed, until every applicable item below has been submitted, fully executed, legible, and correctly dated.
deadlines: ICA 6.2: listing files within 3 business days after the listing agreement is signed; executed contracts, addenda and disclosures within 2 business days after they are binding; the balance before disbursement. Late file fee after 15 days.
seller: Signed listing agreement and all addenda, extensions, and amendments
Agency disclosure, signed and dated at first substantive contact
Compensation agreement / offer of compensation documentation
MLS data entry sheet and any MLS exemption or delayed marketing forms
HOA documents, CC&Rs, and any required disclosures
buyer: Signed buyer-broker agreement (and touring agreement, if used)
Agency disclosure, signed and dated at first substantive contact
Executed purchase contract with all counteroffers and addenda
Proof of funds and/or lender pre-approval
Earnest money receipt and deposit confirmation
Inspection, appraisal, and due diligence resolution documents
closing: All written communications material to the transaction
Cancellation, release, or termination documents if the transaction did not close
